route_note: Frequent regional trains run directly from Milano Centrale or Milano Rogoredo to Pavia in well under an hour, no changes needed.
see: Certosa di Pavia (short bus/taxi from town)

route_note: Direct regional trains from Milano Centrale reach Bergamo in about 50 minutes; from the station, local bus or funicular climbs to Città Alta.
see: Bergamo Cathedral and Santa Maria Maggiore

route_note: Direct trains from Milano Centrale or Milano Cadorna reach Como in 40-60 minutes; boats and the Brunate funicular leave from near the lakefront.
tour_query: Lake Como day trip from Milan

route_note: High-speed trains from Milano Centrale reach Torino Porta Nuova in about an hour with no changes.
Direct high-speed trains from Milano Centrale reach Verona Porta Nuova in roughly 1h15-1h30; the historic centre is a short bus or walk from the station.
